text: NoAtMark Text Hygiene 是一个面向 DSH Web UI 的文本卫生插件，通过 Cordis 将四个工具注册到共享工具目录：sanitize_text 清除隐形字符并标记注入和隐藏文本信号，scan_text 报告隐形字符及位置，clean_format 整理 LLM 输出格式且保留原意，sanitize_csv 转义可能被表格软件解释为公式的单元格。适合在总结粘贴内容、检查文本或清理 AI 输出前调用；代码没有要求额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

NoAtMark Text Hygiene adds four DSH tools: sanitize_text removes invisible characters, scan_text reports hidden signals, clean_format tidies LLM formatting, and sanitize_csv escapes spreadsheet formula prefixes. Use it to inspect text, clean AI output, or prepare CSV.
帮我在把粘贴内容交给模型前清掉零宽字符。
能不能检查一段文本里有没有隐藏字符和注入提示？
把这份 AI 输出的多余空行和代码围栏整理一下。
保存 CSV 前帮我处理可能被表格当公式执行的单元格。
Scan text for invisible characters and hidden prompt signals.
Clean up formatting artifacts in an LLM response without rewriting it.
Escape risky formula prefixes in CSV cells before opening the file.
NoAtMark Text Hygiene 的功能「sanitize_text」：清理输入文本中的零宽字符等不可见字符，并标记提示注入模式与隐藏 HTML 文本信号；注入风险只会被标记，不会自动删除。输入一段文本，返回结构化清理结果。
NoAtMark Text Hygiene 的功能「scan_text」：检查文本中的不可见字符、提示注入模式和隐藏文本信号，报告字符类别、数量、码点与位置，不修改原文。
NoAtMark Text Hygiene 的功能「clean_format」：整理 LLM 文本的换行、空行、尾随空格、代码围栏、过深标题和空列表标记，并返回清理结果及变化统计，不改写内容含义。
NoAtMark Text Hygiene 的功能「sanitize_csv」：处理 CSV 中以 =、+、-、@、制表符或回车开头的单元格，为其加引号前缀；可选提供分隔符，返回处理后的 CSV 与变更数量。
清理模型生成文本的格式，同时保持内容原意。

noatmark-dsh-plugin README · noatmark-dsh-plugin：[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

**NoAtMark text hygiene** as a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin.

Everything-is-a-plugin: this plugin gives your dsh agent four text-hygiene tools, backed by the same deterministic engines behind [noatmark.com](https://noatmark.com).

noatmark-dsh-plugin README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `sanitize_text` | Strip invisible/zero-width characters and flag prompt-injection + hidden-text signals. |
| `scan_text` | Report invisible characters (with code points + positions), injection patterns, and hidden text. |
| `clean_format` | Clean LLM formatting artifacts (blank lines, stray fences, trailing spaces) — meaning untouched. |
| `sanitize_csv` | Escape CSV formula injection (OWASP): `= + - @` prefixes get a leading quote. |
noatmark-dsh-plugin README · Tools：All processing is deterministic and local — no data leaves your machine.

noatmark-dsh-plugin README · Install：Add this plugin to your dsh Web UI. If you're running from a source checkout, use a `cordis.yml` patch:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: noatmark
      name: noatmark-dsh-plugin
```

or point at the source directly (absolute path):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: noatmark
      name: '/path/to/noatmark-dsh-plugin/src/index.ts'
```

Start dsh with the patch:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web --patch ./cordis.yml
```

noatmark-dsh-plugin README · Usage：In a dsh session, ask the agent to use a tool, e.g.:

> Sanitize this pasted text before you summarize it.

> Scan this file for invisible characters.

> Clean the formatting of this AI output.

> Escape this CSV before saving it.

noatmark-dsh-plugin README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build   # tsc -> dist/
```
